chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Separation is made between the boys and the women in the beds when they reach ten years of age.
ai.seo_question: At what age should children be separated from adults in their sleeping quarters according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the age of ten as the threshold for modesty (haya) and privacy within the family unit, a ruling widely accepted in Shia fiqh as the point where children begin to observe gender segregation. It reflects the scholarly emphasis on cultivating natural modesty in children before they reach full puberty, ensuring that domestic spaces maintain appropriate boundaries of visibility and interaction.
